```text
function fmt(d: Date) {
  const day = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
  const time = d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  return `${day} · ${time}`;
}

function fmtPlanDate(d: Date, lang: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === 'hr' ? 'hr-HR' : lang === 'de' ? 'de-DE' : lang === 'sl' ? 'sl-SI' : 'en-GB', { dateStyle: 'medium' }).format(d);
}

function fmtPlanTime(d: Date, lang: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === 'hr' ? 'hr-HR' : lang === 'de' ? 'de-DE' : lang === 'sl' ? 'sl-SI' : 'en-GB', { timeStyle: 'short' }).format(d);
}

function pad(n: number) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }

export default function Planner() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { returnTo, returnToken, returnSection } = useLocalSearchParams<{ returnTo?: string; returnToken?: string; returnSection?: string }>();
  const returnToBeginner = useRef(returnTo === 'beginner');
  const beginnerReturnSection = useRef(returnSection === 'style' ? 'style' : 'plan');
  const { t, lang } = useT();
  const experienceLevel = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel);
  const experienceLoaded = experienceLevel !== undefined;
  const isBeginner = experienceLevel !== 'pro';
  const temperatureUnit = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeTemperatureUnit, getCachedTemperatureUnit, getCachedTemperatureUnit) ?? 'celsius';
  const measurementSystem = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeMeasurementSystem, getCachedMeasurementSystem, getCachedMeasurementSystem) ?? 'metric';
  const [style, setStyle] = useState<PizzaStyle>('neapolitan');
  const [selectedMethod, setSelectedMethod] = useState<Method>('direct');
  const method: Method = isBeginner ? 'direct' : selectedMethod;
  const bakeAt = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeSharedHomeBakeAt, getSharedHomeBakeAt, getSharedHomeBakeAt);
  const directHomeSchedule = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeSharedHomeDirectSchedule, getSharedHomeDirectSchedule, getSharedHomeDirectSchedule);
  const bigaHomeSchedule = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeSharedHomeBigaSchedule, getSharedHomeBigaSchedule, getSharedHomeBigaSchedule);
  const poolishHomeSchedule = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeSharedHomePoolishSchedule, getSharedHomePoolishSchedule, getSharedHomePoolishSchedule);
  const [scheduledPlanKey, setScheduledPlanKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const pendingBeginnerReturnBakeAt = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const effectiveStyle = isBeginner && directHomeSchedule?.style ? directHomeSchedule.style : style;
  const effectiveStyleName = isBeginner && effectiveStyle === 'romana'
    ? directHomeSchedule?.romanFormat === 'teglia' ? 'Romana Teglia' : 'Romana Tonda'
    : t.calc.pizzaStyles[effectiveStyle].name;
  const plannerStepCopy = isBeginner
    ? t.planner.stepCopy
    : { ...t.planner.stepCopy, directHomeCopy: undefined };
  useEffect(() => {
    returnToBeginner.current = returnTo === 'beginner';
    if (returnSection === 'style' || returnSection === 'plan') beginnerReturnSection.current = returnSection;
  }, [returnTo, returnSection, returnToken]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (experienceLoaded && isBeginner) void cancelPlannerNotificationsForMethods(['biga', 'poolish']);
  }, [experienceLoaded, isBeginner]);
  const hasCurrentBeginnerDirectSchedule = !isBeginner || (!!directHomeSchedule && !!bakeAt
    && directHomeSchedule.bakeAt.getTime() === bakeAt.getTime());
  const steps = bakeAt && hasCurrentBeginnerDirectSchedule ? reversePlan(bakeAt, method, effectiveStyle, plannerStepCopy, directHomeSchedule, bigaHomeSchedule, poolishHomeSchedule, lang, formatTemperature(directHomeSchedule?.ovenTemp ?? 250, temperatureUnit)).map((step) => ({
    ...step,
    desc: formatUnitText(step.desc, temperatureUnit, measurementSystem),
  })) : [];
  const planKey = bakeAt ? `${bakeAt.getTime()}-${method}-${effectiveStyle}-${directHomeSchedule?.romanFormat ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.ovenTemp ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.strategy ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.startAt.getTime() ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.roomBeforeFridgeHours ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.fridgeHours ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.roomAfterFridgeHours ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.ballingAt?.getTime() ?? ''}-${directHomeSchedule?.preheatAt?.getTime() ?? ''}-${bigaHomeSchedule?.finalMixAt.getTime() ?? ''}-${poolishHomeSchedule?.finalMixAt.getTime() ?? ''}` : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isBeginner || pendingBeginnerReturnBakeAt.current === null || !bakeAt || !directHomeSchedule) return;
    if (bakeAt.getTime() !== pendingBeginnerReturnBakeAt.current || directHomeSchedule.bakeAt.getTime() !== bakeAt.getTime()) return;
    pendingBeginnerReturnBakeAt.current = null;
    router.replace('/(tabs)?focus=plan');
  }, [isBeginner, bakeAt, directHomeSchedule, router]);

  // Native picker state (iOS/Android)
  const [pickerMode, setPickerMode] = useState<null | 'date' | 'time'>(null);
  const [pickerDraft, setPickerDraft] = useState<Date>(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(19, 0, 0, 0);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
    return d;
  });

  // Web-only: text inputs (native picker doesn't render on web)
  const initial = new Date();
  initial.setHours(19, 0, 0, 0);
  initial.setDate(initial.getDate() + 1);
  const [webDate, setWebDate] = useState<string>(
    `${initial.getFullYear()}-${pad(initial.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(initial.getDate())}`
  );
  const [webTime, setWebTime] = useState<string>(`${pad(initial.getHours())}:${pad(initial.getMinutes())}`);

  // Preset options for "when to bake"
  const now = new Date();
  const nextSat = new Date(now);
  nextSat.setDate(now.getDate() + ((6 - now.getDay() + 7) % 7 || 7));
  nextSat.setHours(18, 0, 0, 0);
  const inTwoDays = new Date(now.getTime() + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  inTwoDays.setHours(19, 0, 0, 0);
  const inFiveHours = new Date(now.getTime() + 5 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const presets = [
    { label: `+5h (${fmt(inFiveHours)})`, date: inFiveHours },
    { label: `+2d (${fmt(inTwoDays)})`, date: inTwoDays },
    { label: `${fmt(nextSat)}`, date: nextSat },
  ];

  const generate = (d: Date) => {
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.invalidDate);
      return false;
    }
    if (d.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.pastDate);
      return false;
    }
    const availableHours = (d.getTime() - Date.now()) / (60 * 60 * 1000);
    if ((isBeginner && availableHours < BEGINNER_DIRECT_MIN_WINDOW_HOURS) || (!isBeginner && availableHours < 1)) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.shortTimeTitle, t.planner.shortTimeMessage, [{ text: t.planner.understand }]);
      return false;
    }
    setSharedHomeBakeAt(d);
    if (isBeginner) {
      AsyncStorage.setItem('beginnerBakeAt', d.toISOString()).catch((error) => {
        console.error('Unable to persist the scheduled bake time:', error);
      });
    }
    setScheduledPlanKey(null);
    if (returnToBeginner.current) {
      returnToBeginner.current = false;
      router.replace(`/(tabs)?focus=${beginnerReturnSection.current}`);
    }
    return true;
  };

  const handlePlannerBack = () => {
    if (returnToBeginner.current) {
      router.replace(`/(tabs)?focus=${beginnerReturnSection.current}`);
    } else {
      router.back();
    }
  };

  const scheduleAll = async () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || !isPushSupported()) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.alarmUnavailable);
      return;
    }
    if (scheduledPlanKey === planKey) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.alarmsAlreadySet);
      return;
    }
    if (!await requestNotificationPermissions()) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.permissionRequired);
      return;
    }
    const futureSteps = steps.filter((s) => s.at.getTime() > Date.now());
    if (!futureSteps.length) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.pastDate);
      return;
    }
    await cancelPlannerNotificationsForMethods(['direct', 'biga', 'poolish']);
    let scheduled = 0;
    for (const s of futureSteps) {
      const trigger = s.at.getTime() - Date.now();
      const id = await scheduleLocal(`🍕 ${s.title}`, s.desc, Math.round(trigger / 1000), { source: 'pizza-planner', method });
      if (id) scheduled += 1;
    }
    if (!scheduled) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.alarmFailed);
      return;
    }
    setScheduledPlanKey(planKey);
    Alert.alert(t.planner.alarmsSet.replace('{N}', String(scheduled)));
  };

  const openDatePicker = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') return; // web uses inline text inputs
    setPickerDraft(bakeAt ?? pickerDraft);
    setPickerMode('date');
  };

  const onPickerChange = (event: any, selected?: Date) => {
    // Android: closes immediately after pick; iOS: keeps open
    const type = event?.type;
    if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
      setPickerMode(null);
      if (type === 'dismissed') return;
    }
    if (selected) {
      setPickerDraft(selected);
      if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
        if (pickerMode === 'date') {
          // After date is picked, immediately open time picker
          setTimeout(() => setPickerMode('time'), 100);
        } else {
          generate(selected);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const iosConfirm = () => {
    setPickerMode(null);
    generate(pickerDraft);
  };

  // Web: build Date from inputs and generate
  const applyWebDateTime = () => {
    // Parse YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM
    const [y, m, d] = webDate.split('-').map((x) => Number(x));
    const [hh, mm] = webTime.split(':').map((x) => Number(x));
    if (!Number.isInteger(y) || !Number.isInteger(m) || !Number.isInteger(d) || !Number.isInteger(hh) || !Number.isInteger(mm)) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.invalidDate);
      return;
    }
    const dt = new Date(y, m - 1, d, hh, mm, 0, 0);
    if (
      Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())
      || dt.getFullYear() !== y
      || dt.getMonth() !== m - 1
      || dt.getDate() !== d
      || dt.getHours() !== hh
      || dt.getMinutes() !== mm
    ) {
      Alert.alert(t.planner.invalidDate);
      return;
    }
    generate(dt);
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { paddingTop: insets.top }]}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Pressable testID="planner-back" accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel="Back" onPress={handlePlannerBack} style={styles.backButton}>
          <Icon name="arrow-back" size={20} color={COLORS.brand} />
          <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Back</Text>
        </Pressable>
        <Text style={styles.title}>{t.planner.title}</Text>
      </View>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ padding: SPACING.lg, paddingBottom: SPACING.xxxl, gap: SPACING.lg }}>
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>{t.planner.style}</Text>
          {isBeginner ? (
            <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>{effectiveStyleName}</Text>
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.chipRow}>
              {(['neapolitan', 'romana', 'ny_style'] as PizzaStyle[]).map((key) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={key}
                  testID={`planner-style-${key}`}
                  onPress={() => setStyle(key)}
                  style={[styles.chip, style === key && styles.chipActive]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.chipText, style === key && { color: '#fff' }]}>{t.calc.pizzaStyles[key].name}</Text>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>{t.planner.method}</Text>
          <View style={styles.chipRow}>
            {[
              { key: 'direct' as const, l: t.calc.direct },
              { key: 'biga' as const, l: t.calc.biga },
              { key: 'poolish' as const, l: t.calc.poolish },
            ].filter((m) => isBeginner ? m.key === 'direct' : true).map((m) => (
              <Pressable
                key={m.key}
                testID={`planner-method-${m.key}`}
                onPress={() => setSelectedMethod(m.key)}
                style={[styles.chip, method === m.key && styles.chipActive]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.chipText, method === m.key && { color: '#fff' }]}>{m.l}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Custom date+time entry */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>{t.planner.customTitle}</Text>

          {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
            <View style={{ gap: SPACING.sm }}>
              <View style={styles.row}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.microLabel}>{t.planner.customDate}</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    testID="web-date"
                    // @ts-expect-error web-only prop
                    type="date"
                    value={webDate}
                    onChangeText={setWebDate}
                    style={styles.textInput}
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.microLabel}>{t.planner.customTime}</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    testID="web-time"
                    // @ts-expect-error web-only prop
                    type="time"
                    value={webTime}
                    onChangeText={setWebTime}
                    style={styles.textInput}
                  />
                </View>
              </View>
              <Pressable testID="web-apply" onPress={applyWebDateTime} style={styles.primaryBtn}>
                <Icon name="calendar" size={16} color="#fff" />
                <Text style={styles.primaryBtnText}>{t.planner.customApply}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <Pressable testID="open-datepicker" onPress={openDatePicker} style={styles.dateBtn}>
              <Icon name="calendar-outline" size={20} color={COLORS.brand} />
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text style={styles.dateBtnLabel}>{bakeAt ? fmt(bakeAt) : t.planner.mobilePickerHint}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.dateBtnSub}>{bakeAt ? t.planner.mobilePickerChange : t.planner.mobilePickerHelp}</Text>
              </View>
              <Icon name="chevron-forward" size={20} color={COLORS.muted} />
            </Pressable>
          )}

          {pickerMode ? (
            <View>
              <DateTimePicker
                value={pickerDraft}
                mode={pickerMode}
                is24Hour
                minimumDate={new Date()}
                display={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'spinner' : 'default'}
                onChange={onPickerChange}
              />
              {Platform.OS === 'ios' ? (
                <View style={styles.iosRow}>
                  <Pressable onPress={() => setPickerMode(null)} style={[styles.iosBtn, { backgroundColor: COLORS.surface, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: COLORS.border }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.iosBtnText, { color: COLORS.onSurface }]}>{t.planner.cancel}</Text>
                  </Pressable>
                  {pickerMode === 'date' ? (
                    <Pressable onPress={() => setPickerMode('time')} style={[styles.iosBtn, { backgroundColor: COLORS.brand }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.iosBtnText}>{t.planner.nextToTime}</Text>
                    </Pressable>
                  ) : (
                    <Pressable onPress={iosConfirm} style={[styles.iosBtn, { backgroundColor: COLORS.brand }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.iosBtnText}>{t.planner.confirm}</Text>
                    </Pressable>
                  )}
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Quick presets */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>{t.planner.presetsTitle}</Text>
          <View style={{ gap: SPACING.sm }}>
            {presets.map((p, i) => (
              <Pressable
                key={i}
                testID={`preset-${i}`}
                onPress={() => generate(p.date)}
                style={[styles.optRow, bakeAt?.getTime() === p.date.getTime() && styles.optRowActive]}
              >
                <Icon name="flash" size={18} color={COLORS.brand} />
                <Text style={styles.optText}>{p.label}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>

        {steps.length > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
              <Text style={styles.stepsHeader}>{t.planner.steps}</Text>
              <Pressable testID="schedule-alarms" onPress={scheduleAll} style={styles.alarmBtn}>
                <Icon name="alarm" size={16} color="#fff" />
                <Text style={styles.alarmBtnText}>{t.planner.setAlarms}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            {steps.map((s, i) => (
              <View key={i} style={styles.stepItem}>
                <View style={styles.stepDot} />
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.stepDate}>{fmtPlanDate(s.at, lang)}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.stepTime}>{fmtPlanTime(s.at, lang)}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>{s.title}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.stepDesc}>{s.desc}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.empty}>
            <Icon name="time-outline" size={40} color={COLORS.muted} />
            <Text style={styles.emptyText}>{t.planner.empty}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: COLORS.surface },
  header: { paddingHorizontal: SPACING.lg, paddingVertical: SPACING.md, gap: SPACING.sm },

  emptyText: { color: COLORS.muted, fontSize: 15 },
});
```

### frontend/app/onboarding.tsx

```text
    1: import { View, Text, StyleSheet, Pressable, ScrollView, Image, ImageSourcePropType } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import Icon from '@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons';

import { useT } from '../src/i18n/LanguageProvider';
import { COLORS, SPACING, RADIUS } from '../src/theme';
import { setExperienceLevel, UserExperienceLevel } from '../src/experienceLevel';

export default function Onboarding() {
  const { t } = useT();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();

  const choose = (level: UserExperienceLevel) => {
    void setExperienceLevel(level);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.root} testID="onboarding-screen">
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={[styles.content, { paddingTop: insets.top + SPACING.lg, paddingBottom: insets.bottom + SPACING.xl }]}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        <View style={styles.brandRow}>
          <View style={styles.brandMark}>
            <Icon name="pizza-outline" size={20} color="#fff" />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.brand}>PizzaBook</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.intro}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>{t.onboarding.title}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{t.onboarding.subtitle}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.cards}>
          <ExperienceCard
            testID="onboarding-beginner"
            title={t.onboarding.beginnerTitle}
            lead={t.onboarding.beginnerLead}
            description={t.onboarding.beginnerDescription}
            benefits={[t.onboarding.beginnerBenefit1, t.onboarding.beginnerBenefit2, t.onboarding.beginnerBenefit3]}
            recommended={t.onboarding.recommended}
            assetLabel={t.onboarding.beginnerAssetLabel}
            chefSource={require('../assets/images/chef-beginner.png')}
            recommendedCard
            onPress={() => choose('beginner')}
          />
          <ExperienceCard
            testID="onboarding-pro"
            title={t.onboarding.proTitle}
            lead={t.onboarding.proLead}
            description={t.onboarding.proDescription}
            benefits={[t.onboarding.proBenefit1, t.onboarding.proBenefit2, t.onboarding.proBenefit3]}
            assetLabel={t.onboarding.proAssetLabel}
            chefSource={require('../assets/images/chef-pro.png')}
            onPress={() => choose('pro')}
          />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

type ExperienceCardProps = {
  testID: string;
  title: string;
  lead: string;
  description: string;
  benefits: string[];
  recommended?: string;
  assetLabel: string;
  chefSource: ImageSourcePropType;
  recommendedCard?: boolean;
  onPress: () => void;
};

function ExperienceCard({
  testID,
  title,
  lead,
  description,
  benefits,
  recommended,
  assetLabel,
  chefSource,
  recommendedCard = false,
  onPress,
}: ExperienceCardProps) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      testID={testID}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={`${title}. ${lead}`}
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.card, recommendedCard && styles.cardRecommended, pressed && styles.cardPressed]}
    >
      {recommended ? (
        <View style={styles.badge}>
          <Text style={styles.badgeText}>{recommended}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View style={styles.cardBody}>
        <View style={styles.cardCopy}>
          <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{title}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.cardLead}>{lead}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.cardDesc}>{description}</Text>
          <View style={styles.benefits}>
            {benefits.map((benefit) => (
              <View key={benefit} style={styles.benefitRow}>
                <Icon name="checkmark" size={15} color={COLORS.success} />
                <Text style={styles.benefitText}>{benefit}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.chefSlot} pointerEvents="none">
          <Image source={chefSource} style={styles.chefImage} resizeMode="contain" accessibilityLabel={assetLabel} />
        </View>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: COLORS.surface },
  content: { paddingHorizontal: SPACING.lg, gap: SPACING.lg },
  brandRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: SPACING.sm },
  brandMark: { width: 34, height: 34, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: RADIUS.md, backgroundColor: COLORS.brand },
  brand: { color: COLORS.onSurface, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: '900' },
```

```text
    1: import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Pressable } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import Icon from '@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons';

import { useT } from '../src/i18n/LanguageProvider';
import { LANGS, Lang } from '../src/i18n/translations';
import { COLORS, SPACING, RADIUS } from '../src/theme';
import { UserExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel, setExperienceLevel, subscribeExperienceLevel } from '../src/experienceLevel';
import {
  MeasurementSystem, PreferredYeastType,
  setTemperatureUnit,
  getCachedMeasurementSystem, setMeasurementSystem, subscribeMeasurementSystem,
  getCachedPreferredYeastType, setPreferredYeastType, subscribePreferredYeastType,
} from '../src/preferences';

export default function Settings() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t, lang, setLang } = useT();
  const experienceLevel = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel);
  const measurementSystem = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeMeasurementSystem, getCachedMeasurementSystem, getCachedMeasurementSystem) ?? 'metric';
  const preferredYeastType = useSyncExternalStore(subscribePreferredYeastType, getCachedPreferredYeastType, getCachedPreferredYeastType) ?? 'fresh';

  // V1: Units also selects its normal temperature display; temperatureUnit stays a separate preference so it can be split later.
  const chooseUnits = (system: MeasurementSystem) => {
    void setMeasurementSystem(system);
    void setTemperatureUnit(system === 'us' ? 'fahrenheit' : 'celsius');
  };

  const chip = (active: boolean, label: string, onPress: () => void, testID: string) => (
    <Pressable key={testID} testID={testID} onPress={onPress} style={[styles.chip, active && styles.chipActive]}>
      <Text style={[styles.chipText, active && styles.chipTextActive]}>{label}</Text>
    </Pressable>
  );

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { paddingTop: insets.top }]} testID="settings-screen">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>{t.profile.preferences.title}</Text>
        <Pressable testID="settings-close" onPress={() => router.back()} hitSlop={8} style={styles.closeBtn}>
          <Icon name="close" size={22} color={COLORS.onSurface} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ padding: SPACING.lg, paddingBottom: insets.bottom + SPACING.xxl, gap: SPACING.lg }}>
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.section}>{t.profile.language}</Text>
          <View style={styles.chipRow}>
            {LANGS.map((l) => chip(lang === l.code, l.label, () => setLang(l.code as Lang), `settings-lang-${l.code}`))}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.section}>{t.profile.preferences.experienceLevel}</Text>
          <View style={styles.chipRow}>
            {chip(experienceLevel === 'beginner', t.profile.preferences.beginner, () => setExperienceLevel('beginner' as UserExperienceLevel), 'settings-experience-beginner')}
            {chip(experienceLevel === 'pro', t.profile.preferences.pro, () => setExperienceLevel('pro' as UserExperienceLevel), 'settings-experience-pro')}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.section}>{t.profile.preferences.units}</Text>
          <View style={styles.chipRow}>
            {chip(measurementSystem === 'metric', t.profile.preferences.metric, () => chooseUnits('metric'), 'settings-units-metric')}
            {chip(measurementSystem === 'us', t.profile.preferences.us, () => chooseUnits('us'), 'settings-units-us')}
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.hint}>
            {measurementSystem === 'us'
              ? 'oz · lb · °F'
              : 'g · kg · °C'}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.section}>{t.profile.preferences.yeast}</Text>
          <View style={styles.chipRow}>
            {chip(preferredYeastType === 'fresh', t.profile.preferences.fresh, () => setPreferredYeastType('fresh' as PreferredYeastType), 'settings-yeast-fresh')}
            {chip(preferredYeastType === 'dry', t.profile.preferences.dry, () => setPreferredYeastType('dry' as PreferredYeastType), 'settings-yeast-dry')}
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: COLORS.surface },
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: SPACING.lg, paddingVertical: SPACING.md },
  title: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: '800', color: COLORS.onSurface, letterSpacing: -0.5 },
  closeBtn: { width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: RADIUS.pill, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: COLORS.surfaceSecondary, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: COLORS.border },
  card: { backgroundColor: COLORS.surfaceSecondary, padding: SPACING.lg, borderRadius: RADIUS.lg, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: COLORS.border, gap: SPACING.sm },
  section: { fontSize: 13, color: COLORS.muted, fontWeight: '700', textTransform: 'uppercase' },
  chipRow: { flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: SPACING.sm },
  chip: { paddingHorizontal: SPACING.md, height: 40, borderRadius: RADIUS.pill, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: COLORS.border, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  chipActive: { backgroundColor: COLORS.brand, borderColor: COLORS.brand },
  chipText: { color: COLORS.onSurface, fontWeight: '600', fontSize: 14 },
  chipTextActive: { color: '#fff' },
  hint: { fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.muted },
});
```

```text
import { Alert, View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Pressable, TextInput, ImageBackground } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import Icon from '@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons';

import { useAuth } from '../../src/auth';

import { LANGS, Lang } from '../../src/i18n/translations';
import { COLORS, SPACING, RADIUS } from '../../src/theme';

export default function Profile() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, logout, deleteAccount, updateProfile } = useAuth();
  const { t, lang, setLang } = useT();

  const [edit, setEdit] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState(user?.name || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(user?.bio || '');
  const [equipment, setEquipment] = useState(user?.equipment || '');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await updateProfile({ name, bio, equipment });
      setEdit(false);
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const removeAccount = () => {
    Alert.alert(t.profile.deleteAccountTitle, t.profile.deleteAccountWarning, [
      { text: t.common.cancel, style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: t.profile.deleteAccount,
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          try {
            await deleteAccount();
          } catch {
            Alert.alert(t.legal.errorTitle, t.legal.accountDeletion.error);
          }
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const legalLinks = (
    <View style={styles.card}>
      <Text style={styles.section}>{t.profile.settings}</Text>
      <Pressable style={styles.linkRow} onPress={() => router.push('/privacy')}>

      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );

  // Anonymous user view - login CTA + language picker
  if (!user) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.root}>

          style={styles.hero}
          resizeMode="cover"
        >

          <View style={[styles.heroInner, { paddingTop: insets.top + SPACING.lg }]}>

  return (

        <View style={styles.card}>

          <View style={{ gap: SPACING.sm }}>

              <Pressable

                <Text style={[styles.langFlag, lang === l.code && { color: '#fff' }]}>{l.flag}</Text>
```

### frontend/app/login.tsx

```text
    1: import { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, Pressable, Platform, ActivityIndicator, ImageBackground } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';
import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';
import Icon from '@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useAuth } from '../src/auth';
import { useT } from '../src/i18n/LanguageProvider';
import { COLORS, SPACING, RADIUS } from '../src/theme';

WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();

export default function Login() {
  const { t } = useT();
  const { signInWithSessionId } = useAuth();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const onLogin = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const redirectUrl = Platform.OS === 'web'
        ? window.location.origin + '/'
        : Linking.createURL('/', { scheme: 'frontend' });
      const authUrl = `https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(redirectUrl)}`;

      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        window.location.href = authUrl;
        return;
      }

      const result: any = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(authUrl, redirectUrl);
      const rawUrl: string = result?.url || (await Linking.getInitialURL()) || '';
      const m = rawUrl.match(/[?#&]session_id=([^&#]+)/);
      if (!m) {
        if (result?.type !== 'cancel') setError('Prijava nije dovršena. Pokušajte ponovno.');
        return;
      }
      await signInWithSessionId(decodeURIComponent(m[1]));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Prijava nije uspjela. Pokušajte ponovno.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.root} testID="login-screen">
      <ImageBackground
        source={{ uri: 'https://images.pexels.com/photos/27600445/pexels-photo-27600445.jpeg' }}
        style={styles.bg}
        resizeMode="cover"
      >
        <LinearGradient
          colors={['rgba(28,25,23,0.15)', 'rgba(28,25,23,0.85)', 'rgba(28,25,23,0.98)']}
          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
        />
        <View style={[styles.content, { paddingTop: insets.top + SPACING.xxxl, paddingBottom: insets.bottom + SPACING.xxl }]}>
          <View style={styles.top}>
            <View style={styles.logoRing}>
              <Text style={styles.logoEmoji}>🍕</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.brand}>Pizzabook</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.bottom}>
            <Text style={styles.title}>{t.login.title}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{t.login.subtitle}</Text>
            {error ? <Text style={styles.error}>{error}</Text> : null}

            <Pressable
              testID="google-login-button"
              onPress={onLogin}
              disabled={busy}
              style={({ pressed }) => [styles.btn, pressed && { opacity: 0.85 }]}
            >
              {busy ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.brand} />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Icon name="logo-google" size={20} color={COLORS.brand} />
                  <Text style={styles.btnText}>{t.login.google}</Text>
                </>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ImageBackground>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: COLORS.surfaceInverse },
  bg: { flex: 1, width: '100%', height: '100%' },
  content: { flex: 1, paddingHorizontal: SPACING.xl, justifyContent: 'space-between' },
  top: { alignItems: 'center', marginTop: SPACING.xxxl },
  logoRing: { width: 88, height: 88, borderRadius: 44, backgroundColor: COLORS.brand, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: SPACING.md },
  logoEmoji: { fontSize: 44 },
```

```text
    1: import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { Platform, View, Text, Pressable, ScrollView, Modal, StyleSheet, LogBox, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useSegments, type Href } from 'expo-router';
import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';
import * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';
import Constants from 'expo-constants';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';

import { AuthProvider, useAuth, api } from '../src/auth';
import { LanguageProvider, useT } from '../src/i18n/LanguageProvider';
import { LANGS, Lang } from '../src/i18n/translations';
import { COLORS } from '../src/theme';
import AnimatedSplash from '../src/components/AnimatedSplash';
import { getCachedExperienceLevel, loadExperienceLevel, subscribeExperienceLevel } from '../src/experienceLevel';
import { loadTemperatureUnit, loadMeasurementSystem, loadPreferredYeastType } from '../src/preferences';
import {
  setupHandlerAndChannel,
  addTapListener,
  getColdStartData,
  getPermissionState,
  requestAndGetDeviceToken,
  isPushSupported,
} from '../src/notifications';

LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true);

// Module-scope setup (safe no-op if unsupported)
setupHandlerAndChannel();

const PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_KEY = 'pushInstallationId';
const UPDATE_ALERT_SHOWN_KEY = 'updateAlertShownVersion';

async function getPushInstallationId() {
  const stored = await AsyncStorage.getItem(PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_KEY);
  if (stored) return stored;
  const generated = `install_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_KEY, generated);
  return generated;
}

function AuthGate() {
  const { user, loading, signInWithSessionId } = useAuth();
  const segments = useSegments();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [animationDone, setAnimationDone] = useState(false);
  const experienceLevel = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel, getCachedExperienceLevel);
  const finishSplashAnimation = useCallback(() => setAnimationDone(true), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadExperienceLevel();
    loadTemperatureUnit();
    loadMeasurementSystem();
    loadPreferredYeastType();
  }, []);

  const openUpdate = async (url: string) => {
    try {
      await WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(url);
    } catch {
      try {
        await Linking.openURL(url);
      } catch {
        Alert.alert('Preuzimanje nije uspjelo', 'Otvori update link ručno u browseru.');
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const manifestUrl = Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.updateManifestUrl;
        const backendUpdate = await api('/api/app-update').catch(() => null);
        let update = backendUpdate;
        if (manifestUrl) {
          const manifestUpdate = await fetch(manifestUrl)
            .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
            .catch(() => null);
          update = manifestUpdate || backendUpdate;
        }
        const currentVersion = Constants.expoConfig?.version || '0.0.0';
        const currentVersionCode = Constants.expoConfig?.android?.versionCode || 0;
        const newerVersion = compareVersions(update?.version || '0.0.0', currentVersion) > 0;
        const newerBuild = Number(update?.version_code || 0) > currentVersionCode;
        if (cancelled || !update?.apk_url || (!newerVersion && !newerBuild)) return;
        const updateKey = `${update.version || '0.0.0'}:${update.version_code || 0}`;
        if (await AsyncStorage.getItem(UPDATE_ALERT_SHOWN_KEY) === updateKey) return;
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(UPDATE_ALERT_SHOWN_KEY, updateKey);
        Alert.alert(
          'Pizzabook update',
          update.message || 'Dostupna je nova verzija Pizzabooka.',
          [
            { text: 'Kasnije', style: 'cancel' },
            { text: 'Preuzmi update', onPress: () => { void openUpdate(update.apk_url); } },
          ],
        );
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  // Handle deep links w/ session_id
  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      const url = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : '';
      const m = url.match(/[?#&]session_id=([^&#]+)/);
      if (m) {
        signInWithSessionId(decodeURIComponent(m[1])).finally(() => {
          try {
            const clean = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
            window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, '', clean);
          } catch {}
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    let stashed: string | null = null;
    const sub = Linking.addEventListener('url', (e) => {
      if (e?.url) stashed = e.url;
      const m = e?.url?.match(/[?#&]session_id=([^&#]+)/);
      if (m) signInWithSessionId(decodeURIComponent(m[1]));
    });

    Linking.getInitialURL().then((url) => {
      const src = url || stashed;
      const m = src?.match(/[?#&]session_id=([^&#]+)/);
      if (m) signInWithSessionId(decodeURIComponent(m[1]));
    });

    return () => sub.remove();
  }, [signInWithSessionId]);

  // Push tap handlers (only when supported)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || !isPushSupported()) return;

    const openNotification = (data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      if (data.source === 'pizza-guided-recipe' && typeof data.stepId === 'string') {
        router.push(`/(tabs)?focus=guided&stepId=${encodeURIComponent(data.stepId)}`);
        return;
      }
      const url = data?.deeplink || data?.action_url;
      if (typeof url !== 'string') return;
      if (url.startsWith('http')) Linking.openURL(url);
      else router.push(url as Href);
    };

    const tapSub = addTapListener(openNotification);

    getColdStartData().then((data) => {
      if (data) openNotification(data);
    });

    (async () => {
      try {
        const { status, canAskAgain } = await getPermissionState();
        if (status !== 'denied' || canAskAgain) return;
        const lastNudge = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pushNudgeAt');
        const oneWeek = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        if (lastNudge && Date.now() - Number(lastNudge) <= oneWeek) return;
        await AsyncStorage.setItem('pushNudgeAt', String(Date.now()));
      } catch {}
    })();

    return () => { try { tapSub.remove(); } catch {} };
  }, [router]);

  // Register push for every installed device, then associate it with the user after login.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || !isPushSupported()) return;
    (async () => {
      const token = await requestAndGetDeviceToken();
      if (!token) return;
      try {
        const installationId = await getPushInstallationId();
        await api('/api/register-push', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            user_id: user?.user_id ?? installationId,
            installation_id: installationId,
            anonymous: !user,
            platform: Platform.OS,
            device_token: token,
          }),
        });
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, [user]);

  // Auth gate: allow anonymous browsing. Only redirect logged-in users off /login.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading) return;
    const inAuth = segments[0] === 'login';
    if (user && inAuth) router.replace('/(tabs)');
  }, [user, loading, segments, router]);

  // Onboarding gate: first launch (no saved experience level) must see it before the rest of the app.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (experienceLevel === undefined) return;
    const inOnboarding = segments[0] === 'onboarding';
    if (experienceLevel === null && !inOnboarding) router.replace('/onboarding');
    else if (experienceLevel !== null && inOnboarding) router.replace('/(tabs)');
  }, [experienceLevel, segments, router]);

  if (loading || !animationDone || experienceLevel === undefined) {
    return <AnimatedSplash onFinish={finishSplashAnimation} />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Stack screenOptions={{ headerShown: false, contentStyle: { backgroundColor: COLORS.surface } }} />
      <WelcomeModal />
    </>
  );
}

function WelcomeModal() {
  const { lang, setLang } = useT();
  const [selectedLang, setSelectedLang] = useState<Lang>(lang);
  const [dontShowAgain, setDontShowAgain] = useState(false);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);
  const copy = WELCOME_COPY[selectedLang];

  useEffect(() => {
    AsyncStorage.getItem('welcomeMessageDismissed').then((value) => {
      setDismissed(value === 'true');
      setReady(true);
    });
  }, []);

  const selectLanguage = (nextLang: Lang) => {
    setSelectedLang(nextLang);
    setLang(nextLang);
  };

  const continueToApp = async () => {
    if (dontShowAgain) await AsyncStorage.setItem('welcomeMessageDismissed', 'true');
    setDismissed(true);
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={ready && !dismissed} animationType="fade" transparent onRequestClose={continueToApp}>
      <View style={styles.welcomeOverlay}>
        <View style={styles.welcomeCard}>
          <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.welcomeContent} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            <Text style={styles.welcomeTitle}>{copy.title}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.welcomeBody}>{copy.body}</Text>

            <Text style={styles.welcomeLanguageTitle}>Jezik / Language / Sprache / Jezik</Text>
            <View style={styles.welcomeLanguages}>
              {LANGS.map((language) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={language.code}
                  testID={`welcome-lang-${language.code}`}
                  onPress={() => selectLanguage(language.code)}
                  style={[styles.welcomeLanguage, selectedLang === language.code && styles.welcomeLanguageActive]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.welcomeLanguageFlag, selectedLang === language.code && styles.welcomeLanguageTextActive]}>{language.flag}</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.welcomeLanguageText, selectedLang === language.code && styles.welcomeLanguageTextActive]}>{language.label}</Text>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>

            <Pressable testID="welcome-dont-show" onPress={() => setDontShowAgain((value) => !value)} style={styles.welcomeCheckRow}>
              <View style={[styles.welcomeCheckbox, dontShowAgain && styles.welcomeCheckboxActive]}>
                {dontShowAgain ? <Text style={styles.welcomeCheckmark}>✓</Text> : null}
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeCheckText}>{copy.dontShow}</Text>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable testID="welcome-continue" onPress={continueToApp} style={styles.welcomeButton}>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeButtonText}>{copy.continue}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function compareVersions(left: string, right: string) {
  const a = left.split('.').map(Number);
  const b = right.split('.').map(Number);
  for (let index = 0; index < Math.max(a.length, b.length); index += 1) {
    const difference = (a[index] || 0) - (b[index] || 0);
    if (difference !== 0) return difference;
  }
  return 0;
}

export default function RootLayout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#F7C894' }}>
      <SafeAreaProvider>
        <LanguageProvider>
          <AuthProvider>
            <AuthGate />
          </AuthProvider>
        </LanguageProvider>
      </SafeAreaProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

```text
    1: import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, FlatList, Pressable, RefreshControl, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';

import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';

import { api, fileUrl, useAuth } from '../../src/auth';
import { useT } from '../../src/i18n/LanguageProvider';
import { COLORS, SPACING, RADIUS } from '../../src/theme';
import PizzaRatingSlider from '../../src/components/PizzaRatingSlider';
import PostMedia from '../../src/components/PostMedia';
import type { PostMediaSource } from '../../src/components/PostMedia';

type Post = {
  post_id: string; user_id: string; author_name: string; author_picture?: string;
  caption: string; image_path?: string; image_url?: string;
  media_urls?: { type: 'image' | 'video'; url: string }[];
  recipe?: any; likes: string[]; likes_count: number; comments_count: number;
  rating?: number | null; ratings_count?: number; viewer_rating?: number;
  created_at: string;
};

function formatPostDate(value: string) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
  return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}

function getPostMedia(post: Post): PostMediaSource[] {
  if (post.media_urls?.length) return post.media_urls.map((media) => ({ type: media.type, uri: fileUrl(media.url) }));
  return post.image_url ? [{ type: 'image', uri: fileUrl(post.image_url) }] : [];
}

export default function Feed() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t } = useT();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<Post[]>([]);
  const [featured, setFeatured] = useState<Post | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadError(false);
    try {
      const [data, feat] = await Promise.all([
        api('/api/posts'),
        api('/api/posts/featured').catch(() => null),
      ]);
      setFeatured(feat);
      setPosts(feat ? data.filter((post: Post) => post.post_id !== feat.post_id) : data);
    } catch {
      setLoadError(true);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { load(); }, [load]));

  const onLike = async (post: Post) => {
    if (!user) { router.push('/login'); return; }
    try {
      Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);
    } catch {}
    try {
      const r = await api(`/api/posts/${post.post_id}/like`, { method: 'POST' });
      setPosts((prev) => prev.map((p) => p.post_id === post.post_id
        ? { ...p, likes_count: r.likes_count, likes: r.liked ? [...p.likes, user!.user_id] : p.likes.filter(u => u !== user!.user_id) }
        : p));
    } catch {}
  };

  const updateLocalRating = (postId: string, rating: number) => {
    setPosts((prev) => prev.map((post) => post.post_id === postId ? { ...post, viewer_rating: rating } : post));
  };

  const saveRating = async (post: Post, rating: number) => {
    if (!user || post.user_id === user.user_id) return;
    try {
      const result = await api(`/api/posts/${post.post_id}/rating`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ rating }) });
      setPosts((prev) => prev.map((item) => item.post_id === post.post_id
        ? { ...item, rating: result.rating, ratings_count: result.ratings_count, viewer_rating: result.viewer_rating }
        : item));
    } catch {}
  };

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: Post }) => {
    const liked = user && item.likes?.includes(user.user_id);
    const media = getPostMedia(item);
    return (
      <Pressable
        testID={`post-card-${item.post_id}`}
        style={styles.card}
        onPress={() => router.push(`/post/${item.post_id}`)}
      >
        <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
          {item.author_picture ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: item.author_picture }} style={styles.avatar} />
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.avatar, styles.avatarFallback]}>
              <Text style={styles.avatarInitial}>{item.author_name?.[0]?.toUpperCase() || '?'}</Text>
            </View>
          )}
          <View style={styles.authorInfo}>
            <Text style={styles.authorName}>{item.author_name}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.postDate}>{formatPostDate(item.created_at)}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        {media.length ? (
          <View style={styles.imageWrap}>
            <PostMedia source={media[0]} style={styles.image} />
            {media.length > 1 ? (
              <View style={styles.mediaCount}>
                <Icon name="images-outline" size={14} color="#fff" />
                <Text style={styles.mediaCountText}>{media.length}</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
            {item.recipe ? (
              <View style={styles.recipeBadge}>
                <Icon name="document-text" size={12} color="#fff" />
                <Text style={styles.recipeBadgeText}>{t.feed.recipe}</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <View style={styles.body}>
          <Text style={styles.caption} numberOfLines={3}>{item.caption}</Text>
          {item.rating ? (
            <View style={styles.ratingRow}>
              <Text style={styles.ratingText}>{t.feed.rating} {item.rating}/5 · {item.ratings_count}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          <View style={styles.actions}>
            <Pressable testID={`like-btn-${item.post_id}`} onPress={() => onLike(item)} style={styles.action}>
              <Icon name={liked ? 'flame' : 'flame-outline'} size={20} color={liked ? COLORS.brand : COLORS.muted} />
              <Text style={[styles.actionText, liked && { color: COLORS.brand, fontWeight: '700' }]}>{item.likes_count}</Text>
            </Pressable>
            <View style={styles.action}>
              <Icon name="chatbubble-outline" size={18} color={COLORS.muted} />
              <Text style={styles.actionText}>{item.comments_count}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          {user && item.user_id !== user.user_id ? (
            <View style={styles.rateOnWall}>
              <Text style={styles.rateOnWallTitle}>{t.feed.rating}</Text>
              <PizzaRatingSlider
                value={item.viewer_rating || 0}
                onChange={(rating) => updateLocalRating(item.post_id, rating)}
                onChangeEnd={(rating) => { void saveRating(item, rating); }}
                testID={`pizza-rating-${item.post_id}`}
              />
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </Pressable>
    );
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { paddingTop: insets.top }]}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={styles.headerCopy}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>{t.feed.title}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.headerSubtitle}>{t.feed.subtitle}</Text>
        </View>
        <Pressable
          testID="new-post-button"
          onPress={() => user ? router.push('/new-post') : router.push('/login')}
          accessibilityLabel={t.feed.newPost}
          style={styles.newBtn}
        >
          <Icon name="add" size={22} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.center}><ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.brand} /></View>
      ) : loadError ? (
        <View style={styles.empty}>
          <Icon name="cloud-offline-outline" size={48} color={COLORS.muted} />
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>{t.feed.loadError}</Text>
          <Pressable style={styles.emptyBtn} onPress={() => { void load(); }}>
            <Text style={styles.emptyBtnText}>{t.feed.retry}</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : posts.length === 0 && !featured ? (
        <View style={styles.empty}>
          <Icon name="pizza-outline" size={56} color={COLORS.brand} />
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>{t.feed.empty}</Text>
          <Pressable style={styles.emptyBtn} onPress={() => user ? router.push('/new-post') : router.push('/login')}>
            <Text style={styles.emptyBtnText}>{t.feed.newPost}</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={posts}
          keyExtractor={(p) => p.post_id}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          ListHeaderComponent={
            <View style={styles.listHeader}>
              {featured ? (
                <Pressable
                  testID="featured-post"
                  onPress={() => router.push(`/post/${featured.post_id}`)}
                  style={styles.featured}
                >
                  {getPostMedia(featured)[0] ? (
                    <PostMedia source={getPostMedia(featured)[0]} style={styles.featuredImage} />
                  ) : null}
                  <LinearGradient colors={['transparent', 'rgba(28,25,23,0.95)']} style={styles.featuredScrim} />
                  <View style={styles.featuredBadge}>
                    <Icon name="trophy" size={12} color="#fff" />
                    <Text style={styles.featuredBadgeText}>{t.feed.featured}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.featuredBody}>
                    <Text style={styles.featuredName}>{featured.author_name}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.featuredCaption} numberOfLines={2}>{featured.caption}</Text>
                    <View style={styles.featuredMeta}>
                      <Icon name="flame" size={14} color="#fff" />
                      <Text style={styles.featuredMetaText}>{featured.likes_count}</Text>
                      <Icon name="chatbubble-outline" size={13} color="#fff" />
                      <Text style={styles.featuredMetaText}>{featured.comments_count}</Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                </Pressable>
              ) : null}
              {posts.length ? (
                <View style={styles.latestHeader}>
                  <Text style={styles.latestTitle}>{t.feed.latest}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.latestCount}>{posts.length}</Text>
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          }
          contentContainerStyle={{ padding: SPACING.lg, paddingBottom: SPACING.xxxl, gap: SPACING.lg }}
          refreshControl={<RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={() => { setRefreshing(true); load(); }} tintColor={COLORS.brand} />}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
```

### frontend/app/post/[id].tsx

```text
    1: import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { Alert, View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Pressable, TextInput, ActivityIndicator, Platform, KeyboardAvoidingView, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import Icon from '@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons';

import { api, fileUrl, useAuth } from '../../src/auth';
import { useT } from '../../src/i18n/LanguageProvider';
import { COLORS, SPACING, RADIUS } from '../../src/theme';
import { getCachedTemperatureUnit, subscribeTemperatureUnit, getCachedMeasurementSystem, subscribeMeasurementSystem } from '../../src/preferences';
import { formatTemperature, formatWeight } from '../../src/units';
import PizzaRatingSlider from '../../src/components/PizzaRatingSlider';
import PostMedia from '../../src/components/PostMedia';
import type { PostMediaSource } from '../../src/components/PostMedia';

export default function PostDetail() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const { t } = useT();
  const temperatureUnit = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeTemperatureUnit, getCachedTemperatureUnit, getCachedTemperatureUnit) ?? 'celsius';
  const measurementSystem = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeMeasurementSystem, getCachedMeasurementSystem, getCachedMeasurementSystem) ?? 'metric';
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const [post, setPost] = useState<any>(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [posting, setPosting] = useState(false);
  const [savingRecipe, setSavingRecipe] = useState(false);
  const [recipeSaved, setRecipeSaved] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [activeMediaIndex, setActiveMediaIndex] = useState(0);
  const mediaScrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    void Promise.all([api(`/api/posts/${id}`), api(`/api/posts/${id}/comments`)]).then(([p, c]) => {
      if (mounted) { setPost(p); setComments(c); }
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [id]);

  const submitComment = async () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setPosting(true);
    try {
      const c = await api(`/api/posts/${id}/comments`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: text.trim() }) });
      setComments((prev) => [...prev, c]);
      setText('');
    } catch {} finally { setPosting(false); }
  };

  const saveRecipe = async () => {
    if (!post?.recipe) return;
    if (!user) {
      router.push('/login');
      return;
    }
    setSavingRecipe(true);
    try {
      await api('/api/recipes', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: post.recipe.name || `${post.author_name} · ${post.recipe.method || 'recept'}`,
          recipe: {
            ...post.recipe,
            settings: post.recipe.settings || null,
          },
        }),
      });
      setRecipeSaved(true);
    } catch {} finally {
      setSavingRecipe(false);
    }
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!user || user.user_id !== post?.user_id || deleting) return;
    Alert.alert(t.feed.deletePostTitle, t.feed.deletePostWarning, [
      { text: t.common.cancel, style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: t.feed.deletePost,
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          setDeleting(true);
          try {
            await api(`/api/posts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            router.back();
          } catch {
            setDeleting(false);
            Alert.alert(t.feed.deletePostError);
          }
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const report = (targetType: 'post' | 'comment', targetId: string) => {
    if (!user) {
      router.push('/login');
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert(t.profile.report, '', [
      { text: t.common.cancel, style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: t.profile.report,
        onPress: async () => {
          try {
            await api('/api/reports', {
              method: 'POST',
              body: JSON.stringify({ target_type: targetType, target_id: targetId, reason: t.legal.report.violationReason }),
            });
            Alert.alert(t.profile.reportSent);
          } catch {
            Alert.alert(t.legal.errorTitle, t.legal.report.error);
          }
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const onLike = async () => {
    if (!post) return;
    try {
      const r = await api(`/api/posts/${id}/like`, { method: 'POST' });
      setPost({ ...post, likes_count: r.likes_count, likes: r.liked ? [...(post.likes || []), user!.user_id] : (post.likes || []).filter((u: string) => u !== user!.user_id) });
    } catch {}
  };

  if (!post) {
    return <View style={[styles.root, { alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }]}><ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.brand} /></View>;
  }

  const liked = user && post.likes?.includes(user.user_id);
  const media: PostMediaSource[] = post.media_urls?.length
    ? post.media_urls.map((item: { type: 'image' | 'video'; url: string }) => ({ type: item.type, uri: fileUrl(item.url) }))
    : post.image_url ? [{ type: 'image', uri: fileUrl(post.image_url) }] : [];
  const gallerySize = Math.min(windowWidth, 720);
  const goToMedia = (index: number) => {
    const nextIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(media.length - 1, index));
    setActiveMediaIndex(nextIndex);
    mediaScrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ x: nextIndex * gallerySize, animated: true });
  };
  return (
    <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'} style={styles.root}>
        <View style={[styles.header, { paddingTop: insets.top + SPACING.sm }]}>
        <Pressable onPress={() => router.back()}><Icon name="chevron-back" size={26} color={COLORS.onSurface} /></Pressable>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>{post.author_name}</Text>
          {user?.user_id === post.user_id ? (
            <Pressable testID="delete-post" onPress={confirmDelete} hitSlop={8} disabled={deleting}>
              <Icon name="trash-outline" size={22} color={COLORS.error} />
            </Pressable>
          ) : (
            <Pressable onPress={() => report('post', post.post_id)} hitSlop={8}>
              <Icon name="flag-outline" size={22} color={COLORS.error} />
            </Pressable>
          )}
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: SPACING.xxxl }} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
        {media.length ? (
          <View style={[styles.galleryFrame, { width: gallerySize, height: gallerySize }]}>
          <ScrollView
            ref={mediaScrollRef}
            horizontal
            pagingEnabled
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            style={[styles.mediaGallery, { width: gallerySize, height: gallerySize }]}
            onMomentumScrollEnd={(event) => {
              setActiveMediaIndex(Math.round(event.nativeEvent.contentOffset.x / gallerySize));
            }}
          >
            {media.map((item, index) => (
              <View key={`${item.uri}-${index}`} style={[styles.mediaSlide, { width: gallerySize, height: gallerySize }]}>
                <PostMedia source={item} style={styles.image} />
              </View>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
          {media.length > 1 ? (
            <>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityLabel="Prethodna slika"
                onPress={() => goToMedia(activeMediaIndex - 1)}
                disabled={activeMediaIndex === 0}
                style={[styles.galleryArrow, styles.galleryArrowLeft, activeMediaIndex === 0 && styles.galleryArrowDisabled]}
              >
                <Icon name="chevron-back" size={24} color="#fff" />
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityLabel="Sljedeća slika"
                onPress={() => goToMedia(activeMediaIndex + 1)}
                disabled={activeMediaIndex === media.length - 1}
                style={[styles.galleryArrow, styles.galleryArrowRight, activeMediaIndex === media.length - 1 && styles.galleryArrowDisabled]}
              >
                <Icon name="chevron-forward" size={24} color="#fff" />
              </Pressable>
              <View style={styles.galleryDots}>
                {media.map((item, index) => (
                  <View key={`${item.uri}-dot-${index}`} style={[styles.galleryDot, index === activeMediaIndex && styles.galleryDotActive]} />
                ))}
              </View>
            </>
          ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <View style={styles.body}>
          <Text style={styles.caption}>{post.caption}</Text>
          <View style={styles.actions}>
            <Pressable onPress={onLike} testID="like-detail" style={styles.action}>
              <Icon name={liked ? 'flame' : 'flame-outline'} size={22} color={liked ? COLORS.brand : COLORS.muted} />
              <Text style={[styles.actionText, liked && { color: COLORS.brand, fontWeight: '700' }]}>{post.likes_count}</Text>
            </Pressable>
            <View style={styles.action}>
              <Icon name="chatbubble-outline" size={20} color={COLORS.muted} />
              <Text style={styles.actionText}>{comments.length}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {post.recipe ? (
            <View style={styles.recipeCard}>
              <Text style={styles.recipeTitle}>{t.feed.recipe}</Text>
              {post.recipe.style_id && t.calc.pizzaStyles[post.recipe.style_id as keyof typeof t.calc.pizzaStyles] ? <RecipeLine label={t.calc.pizzaStyle} value={t.calc.pizzaStyles[post.recipe.style_id as keyof typeof t.calc.pizzaStyles].name} /> : null}
              {post.recipe.hydration ? <RecipeLine label={t.feed.hydration} value={`${post.recipe.hydration}%`} /> : null}
              {post.recipe.method ? <RecipeLine label={t.feed.method} value={post.recipe.method} /> : null}
              {post.recipe.dough_weight ? <RecipeLine label={t.calc.doughBall} value={formatWeight(post.recipe.dough_weight, measurementSystem)} /> : null}
              {post.recipe.flour_type ? <RecipeLine label={t.feed.flourType} value={post.recipe.flour_type} /> : null}
              {post.recipe.bake_temp ? <RecipeLine label={t.feed.bakeTemp} value={formatTemperature(post.recipe.bake_temp, temperatureUnit)} /> : null}
              <Pressable testID="save-shared-recipe" onPress={() => { void saveRecipe(); }} disabled={savingRecipe || recipeSaved} style={[styles.saveRecipeBtn, (savingRecipe || recipeSaved) && { opacity: 0.65 }]}>
                <Icon name={recipeSaved ? 'checkmark' : 'bookmark-outline'} size={17} color={COLORS.brand} />
                <Text style={styles.saveRecipeText}>{recipeSaved ? t.calc.savedRecipes : t.calc.saveRecipe}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          <RatingSection post={post} onUpdate={setPost} />

          <Text style={[styles.section, { marginTop: SPACING.xl }]}>{t.feed.comment}s ({comments.length})</Text>
          {comments.map((c) => (
            <View key={c.comment_id} style={styles.comment}>
              <View style={styles.commentAvatar}><Text style={styles.commentAvatarText}>{c.author_name?.[0]?.toUpperCase() || '?'}</Text></View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text style={styles.commentName}>{c.author_name}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.commentText}>{c.text}</Text>
              </View>
              <Pressable onPress={() => report('comment', c.comment_id)} hitSlop={8}>
                <Icon name="flag-outline" size={18} color={COLORS.muted} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={[styles.inputBar, { paddingBottom: insets.bottom + SPACING.sm }]}>
        <TextInput
          testID="comment-input"
          value={text}
          onChangeText={setText}
          placeholder={t.feed.addComment}
          placeholderTextColor={COLORS.muted}
          style={styles.commentInput}
        />
        <Pressable testID="send-comment" onPress={submitComment} disabled={!text.trim() || posting} style={[styles.sendBtn, (!text.trim() || posting) && { opacity: 0.5 }]}>
          <Icon name="send" size={18} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </KeyboardAvoidingView>
  );
}

function RecipeLine({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.recipeLine}>
      <Text style={styles.recipeLabel}>{label}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.recipeValue}>{value}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function RatingSection({ post, onUpdate }: { post: any; onUpdate: (p: any) => void }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { t } = useT();
  const isAuthor = user?.user_id === post.user_id;
  const canRate = !!user && !isAuthor;
  const communityRating = post.rating || 0;
  const [draftRating, setDraftRating] = useState(() => post.viewer_rating || 0);

  const saveRating = async (n: number) => {
    if (!canRate) return;
    try {
      const result = await api(`/api/posts/${post.post_id}/rating`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ rating: n }) });
      onUpdate({ ...post, rating: result.rating, ratings_count: result.ratings_count, viewer_rating: result.viewer_rating });
    } catch {}
  };

  if (!communityRating && !canRate) return null;

  return (
    <View style={styles.ratingCard}>
      <Text style={styles.ratingTitle}>{t.feed.rating}</Text>
      {canRate ? (
        <PizzaRatingSlider value={draftRating} onChange={setDraftRating} onChangeEnd={saveRating} testID="pizza-rating-slider" />
      ) : (
        <Text style={styles.ratingSummary}>{communityRating}/5 · {post.ratings_count || 0}</Text>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: COLORS.surface },
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: SPACING.lg, paddingBottom: SPACING.md, backgroundColor: COLORS.surfaceSecondary, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: COLORS.border },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 17, fontWeight: '700', color: COLORS.onSurface },
  galleryFrame: { alignSelf: 'center', position: 'relative', backgroundColor: COLORS.surfaceTertiary },
  image: { width: '100%', height: '100%' },
  mediaGallery: { alignSelf: 'center' },
  mediaSlide: { flexGrow: 0, backgroundColor: COLORS.surfaceTertiary },
  galleryArrow: { position: 'absolute', top: '50%', marginTop: -22, width: 44, height: 44, borderRadius: 22, backgroundColor: 'rgba(28,25,23,0.72)', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  galleryArrowLeft: { left: SPACING.md },
  galleryArrowRight: { right: SPACING.md },
  galleryArrowDisabled: { opacity: 0.25 },
  galleryDots: { position: 'absolute', bottom: SPACING.md, left: 0, right: 0, flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6 },
  galleryDot: { width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)' },
  galleryDotActive: { width: 18, backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  body: { padding: SPACING.lg },
  caption: { fontSize: 16, color: COLORS.onSurface, lineHeight: 22 },
  actions: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: SPACING.xl, marginTop: SPACING.md, paddingBottom: SPACING.md, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: COLORS.divider },
  action: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 },
  actionText: { color: COLORS.muted, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '600' },
```
